welcome.heading: A boutique practice with a family feel
paragraphs: ProDenta is a private dental practice in Battersea, on St. John's Hill opposite the St John's Therapy Centre and a 10 minute walk from both Clapham Junction and Wandsworth Town stations.
We want to keep you, your family and your friends healthy and happy. Every patient is treated in a friendly, cheerful environment with a focus on care and clear communication.
Our emphasis is on prevention, so we work closely with you to explain how dental disease occurs and how best to reduce your risk of problems.
